source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods, USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations, Adapted from a recipe submitted by Alicson Scott, Chickasaw Nation, Get Fresh! Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: low-sodium whole kernel corn, about 23 ounces

steps.instruction: Add 1 pound of ground beef to a large pan over medium heat.
steps.spoken: Add 1 pound of ground beef to a large pan over medium heat. Brown the beef for 8 to ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain the fat off the beef.
Add 1 1/2 cans of corn and 1 can of carrots to the pot.
Add 1 can of sliced potatoes and 1 can of diced tomatoes to the pot.
Add 1 small diced onion to the pot.
Cook over medium heat for 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cook over medium heat for 25 minutes. Stir about every ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup of dry macaroni to the pot.
Add 1 teaspoon of garlic powder and 1 teaspoon of onion powder.
Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Stir about every ten minutes.
